description.value: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a well-known fast food chain specializing in Louisiana-style fried chicken and Cajun-inspired sides. This Cook Street location sits in one of Victoria's most walkable and cyclist-friendly neighbourhoods, close to Beacon Hill Park and the Dallas Road waterfront route. No drive-through means the entrance is pedestrian- and cyclist-oriented, with takeout orders available.
